automation_evidence.quote: it can automatically retrieve the relevant PPG signal and process it for HR estimation.

metric_evidence.quote: our agent achieves the lowest error rates, with an MAE of 2.83, RMSE of 5.47, MAPE of 0.04, and MAD of 1.90.

evidence.quote: Signal quality assessment: This stage incorporates a well-established model [24] to distinguish clean PPG signals from noisy or artifact-affected segments.

practical_problems.note: Quality assessment and GAN reconstruction target motion artifacts, but no ablation or noise sweep isolates them; only end-to-end agent vs GPT comparison.

summary: An orchestrator agent retrieves wearable PPG and runs a fixed processing pipeline for HR estimation, giving lower error than GPT-4o-mini and GPT-4o with code interpreter on 12 held-out participants.
